第一章 总则 
Chapter 1 General Rules 
1.0 营运船舶的能耗、能效和CO2 排放受到多种因素影响，为了满足国际、国内的相关要
求，同时也考虑到船公司降低成本、持续发展的需要，必须用系统的方法进行船舶能
效管理，更经济、更有效地提高船舶能效,减少CO2排放，最有效的途径是建立船舶能
效管理体系，将能效管理纳入公司整体的结构化的管理体系予以实施。  
Energy consumption, energy efficiency and CO2 emissions from operating ships are affected by a variety 
of factors. In order to meet international and domestic requirements, to reduce the cost and maintain 
sustainable development of the shipping company, and to improve energy efficiency and reduce CO2 
emissions more effectively, the most effective way is building a systematic approach to ship energy 
efficiency management and implementing it as part of the company’s overall management system. 
2.0 能效管理成功实施有赖于公司最高管理者的承诺和船、岸人员的参与。通过船舶能效
管理计划的实施，公司/船舶可以：  
Successful implementation of the energy efficiency management depends on the commitment of the 
company's top managers and the participation of all parties both on board and on shore. With the 
implementation of SEEMP, the company/ship can: 
 应用系统理论将船舶的能效管理工作与国际公约、法律法规、标准及其他要求有机
结合，使之相互协调、相互促进，规范合理地降低船舶的能源消耗、提高能源利用
效率、减少CO2排放。 
Apply the systematic theory to combine ship energy efficiency management with international 
conventions, laws and regulations, standar ds and other requirement s so as to coordinate with one 
another, promote and standardize the energy consumption of the ship, improve the energy efficiency  
rate and reduce CO2 emission. 
 利用过程方法对船舶运输/作业中的能效因素进行优化和控制， 实现对能效管理全过
程的控制和持续改进。  
Apply the process metho d to optimize and control the energy efficiency factors in ship 
transportation/operation, to realize the control and continuous improvement of the whole energy 
efficiency management process. 
 应用先进有效的节能技术和方法、挖掘和利用最佳的节能实践与经验。 
Apply advanced and effective ener gy-saving technologies and methods, and follow the best 
energy-saving practices and experience. 
 提高船舶能效管理的有效性，改进其整体绩效。 
Improve the effectiveness and the overall performance of ship energy efficiency management. 
 通过成功地实施本计划要求， 使相关方/利益方确信其已经建立了适宜的船舶能效管
理体系。 
By s uccessfully implementing the plan, ensure the stakeholders / stakeholders that a suitable ship 
energy efficiency management system has been established.

4.0 “能效管理体系”基于被称为策划－实施－检查－改进（PDCA ）的运行模式。关于
PDCA的含意和内容简要说明如下：  
The "energy efficiency management system" is based on an operating called PDCA, i.e. Plan - Do - 
Check- Adjust. Here is a brief explanation: 
 策划：识别和确认船公司/船舶的能效因素；识别有关的国际公约、法律法规、标准
及其他要求；识别并采用适用的节能技术和最佳节能实践；通过分析确定能效管理
基准，可行时确定标杆；建立能效方针和目标、指标，制订能效管理计划。 
Plan: Identify and confirm the energy efficiency factors of the shipping company / ships; identify 
relevant international conventions, laws and regulations, standards and other requirements; identify 
and adopt applicable energy-saving technologies and best energy- saving practices; determine energy 
efficiency management baseline and benchmarks through analysis  (if applicable) , establish energy 
efficiency policies, targets and indicators, and develop energy efficiency management plans. 
 实施：提供所需的资源，明确作用、职责和权限；确定能力、培训和意识的要求并
进行培训；建立信息交流机制；建立所需的文件和记录；实施运行控制；实施能效
管理计划并开展相关活动。  
Do: Provide the necessary resources, clarify roles, responsibilities and authority; identify 
competencies, training and awareness requirements and start training; establish information exchange 
mechanisms; establish required documentation and records; implement operational controls; 
implement energy efficiency management plans and carry out relevant activities. 
 检查与纠正：对能效管理活动和能效目标实现情况进行监测、测量和评价；识别和
处理不符合；开展内部审核和评审。 
Check and  Correct: Conduct monitoring, measurement and evaluation of energy efficiency 
management activities and energy efficiency targets; identify and handle nonconformities; conduct

5.0 能效管理体系的详细和复杂程度、体系文件的多少、所投入资源的多少等，取决于多
方面因素，如体系覆盖的范围、船公司的规模、船舶的类型/航线、船舶的技术状况及
相关方的要求等。  
The extent and complexity of the energy efficiency management system, the number of system 
documents, the amount of resources  invested, etc., depend on various factors such as the scope of the 
system, the size of the shipping company, the type/route of the ship, the technical condition of the ship, 
requirements from related parties and so on. 
6.0 实施能效管理体系要求能够改进公司/船舶的能效管理绩效，但能效管理体系的成功实
施还需要相关技术和方法的支持。因此，船公司/船舶应在适宜和经济条件许可时，考
虑采用最佳可行的节能技术方法，同时充分考虑到采用这些节能技术和方法的成本效
益。  
Energy efficiency management performance of the company/ship can be improved by implementing  
the energy efficiency management system, however, successful implementation also requires the support 
of relevant technologies and methods. Therefore, the shipping company/ships , when appropriate and 
economic conditions permit, should consider adopting the best possible energy- saving technology 
approach while taking into account the cost-effectiveness of these technologies and methods. 
7.0 公司能效管理方针和目标 
Energy Efficiency Management Policy and Objectives 
7.1 公司能效管理方针： 
Energy Efficiency Management Policy: 
恪尽职守 节能减排 
Fulfill duties, save energy. 
7.2 公司能效管理目标： 
Energy Efficiency Management Objectives: 
提供必需的资源，提供最佳的措施； 
Provide necessary resources and best measures; 
制定船舶能效管理计划，建立能效管理机制； 
Develop ship energy efficiency management plans and establish energy efficiency management 
mechanism; 
培训船岸员工，提高能效管理意识和技能； 
Training of all staff to raise energy efficiency management awareness and improve skills; 
定期评估能效管理措施的有效性，不断改进、完善和执行计划 。 
Regularly assess the effectiveness of energy efficiency management measures, and continuously 
improve, improve and implement the plan. 
8.0 定义及缩写  
Definitions and Abbreviations

.2 分支机构: 系指隶属于相同能效管理体系，受公司控制并构成公司一部分的机构。  
Branch: A body that belongs to the same energy efficiency management system, which is part of the

.3 能效: 能源利用效率，即得到的结果与所使用的能源之间的关系。

Energy Efficiency Factors: Factors affecting ship energy consumption, energy efficiency and CO2 
emissions during transport/operation services. 
.5 能效管理体系: 公司管理体系的一部分， 用于建立能效方针、 目标和管理能效因素，
并实现这些方针和目标的一系列相互关联要素的集合，包括公司结构、职责、惯
例、程序、过程和资源。  
Energy Efficiency M anagement S ystem: Part of the company's management system, a set of 
interrelated elements for the establishment of energy efficiency policies, objectives and management 
of energy efficiency factors and the achievement of these policies and objectives, including 
corporate structure, responsibilities, protocols, procedures, processes and resources 
.6 能效方针: 由公司的最高管理者正式发布的船舶能效管理的宗旨和方向。 
Energy Efficiency P olicy: Ship energy efficiency management purpose and direction officially 
released by the company's top managers. 
.7 能效目标: 公司所要实现的降低船舶能耗、 提高能源利用效率、 减少CO2排放的总
体要求。 
Energy Efficiency O bjectives: The overall requirements of ship energy consumption and CO2 
emissions reduction, energy efficiency improvement that the company aims to achieve. 
.8 能效指标: 由能效目标产生的， 为实现能效目标所需规定的具体要求。 它们可适用
于整个公司或其局部（包括船舶）。 
Energy Efficiency Indicators: Specific standards required to achieve the energy efficiency objectives, 
derived from the objectives. T he indicators  may apply to the whole or part pf the company 
(including ships). 
.9 能效数据: 能效数据是指计算能耗、能效和CO2排放的所有相关数据。 
Energy Efficiency D ata: Energy efficiency data refers to all relevant data for calculating energy 
consumption, energy efficiency and CO2 emissions. 
.10 能效管理基准: 公司针对船舶/船队能效管理情况， 确定作为比较基础的能源消耗、
能源利用效率及CO2排放的水平。 
Energy Efficiency Management Baseline: Based on the energy efficiency management performance, 
the company establishes  a certain level of energy consumption, energy efficiency and CO2 
emissions as a basis to be compared with. 
.11 能效管理标杆: 公司参照船舶同类可比活动所确定的能源消耗、能源利用效率和
CO2排放的水平。 
Energy Efficiency Management B enchmark: Level of energy consumption, energy efficiency and 
CO2 emissions established by referring to similar comparable activities of the ships. 
.12 能效设计指数: 是衡量新船CO2效能的一个指标,即根据船舶在设计最大载货状态

第二章  管理职责 
Chapter 2  Management responsibilities  
1.0 管理承诺   Management Commitment 
公司最高管理者通过以下活动，对建立、实施、保持 能效管理计划和持续改进其有效
性所做出的承诺提供证据：  
The top management of the company provides evidence of the commitment to establish, implement, 
maintain an EEMP and continually improve its effectiveness through: 
1.1 执行适用的国际公约、法律法规、标准及其他要求并在公司内贯彻实施； 
Implementing applicable international conventions, laws and regulations, standards and other 
requirements and implement them within the company; 
1.2 公司制定和实施能效方针和目标，并作为公司战略目标和发展方向的组成部分；  
Developing and implementing energy efficiency policies and objectives, and as part of the company's 
strategic objectives and development direction; 
1.3 进行管理评审；  
Conducting management review; 
1.4 确保配备能效管理体系所需的适宜资源。  
Making available the appropriate resources for the Energy Efficiency Management System. 
2.0 能效方针   Energy Efficiency Policy 
2.1 公司能效管理方针见第一章。 
Please refer to Chapter 1. 
2.2 能效管理方针是公司降低船舶能源消耗、 提高能源利用效率、 减少CO2排放并持续改进
工作的宗旨和方向，是实施和改进公司能效管理体系的推动力。 
Energy Efficiency Management P olicy provides purpose and direction for the compa ny to reduce the 
ship's energy consumption, improve energy efficiency, reduce CO2 emissions and to develop and 
improve continuously. It is the driving force of the implementation and improvement of the company's 
energy efficiency management system. 
2.3 公司总经理制定能效管理方针，公司最高管理层和指定人员参与能效管理方针的制定，
并保证船岸各级机构均能执行和保持公司的能效管理方针。 
General manager of the company is responsible for developing the Energy Efficiency Management  
Policy, while top management and designated personnel participate in the development process, to ensure 
that all departments, on board or on shore, can  all implement and maintain the company's Energy 
Efficiency Management Policy. 
2.4 公司的能效管理方针由公司总经理批准发布。 
Energy Efficiency Management Policy is approved and released by the company's general manager. 
2.5 公司能效管理方针应适用于公司船舶运输/作业服务的特点，并与公司已有的其他管理
体系方针相协调； 
The Energy Efficiency M anagement P olicy should be in line with  the characteristics of the ship 
transport/operations services and be coordinated with other management systems  and policies that the 
company already has; 
2.6 公司通过人员会议、培训、内审等方法，把公司的能效管理方针传达到每一个员工，
确保能效管理方针得到贯彻。 
The company will pass the Energy Efficiency Management P olicy to e ach employee through staff 
meeting, training, internal audit and other methods, to ensure that energy efficiency management policy is 
implemented.
